verdict.line: On AMD EPYC 9V45 96-Core Processor: loops that lose SIMD under the check (k04_rev, k05_stride2, k08_matmul) cost 2.86 to 5.80 times as long in cache (median 4.00; as compiled, median 4.51); judged forward loops (k01_sum_fwd, k02_add_fwd, k03_stencil) cost at most 1.3% more with loops aligned. Placement-sensitive cells, listed separately and not judged: k02_add_fwd.L1 (as compiled 1.01, aligned 0.83); k03_stencil.L1 (as compiled 0.99, aligned 1.01).
verdict.why: MAP: every counted in-cache cell of k01_sum_fwd, k02_add_fwd, k03_stencil has aligned ratio <= 1.02 and aligned ci95_hi <= 1.0200; every in-cache cell of k04_rev, k05_stride2, k08_matmul has ci95_lo >= 1.5 in both columns; placement-sensitive (layout A/A half-width 0.58%): k02_add_fwd.L1, k03_stencil.L1

verdict_v1.line: INCONCLUSIVE: a mixed picture that fits neither the map nor holds-everywhere (forward rule missed by k02_add_fwd.L1; cells above the forward limit: k04_rev.L1, k04_rev.L2, k05_stride2.L1, k05_stride2.L2, k08_matmul.L1, k08_matmul.L2); no headline number is printed.
